deals.one_line_description: Tokenized title registry pilots with two Thai provincial land offices.
deals.editorial_note: SAMPLE. Land titles are the RWA endgame in Thailand. Government pilots move slowly, then all at once.

deals.one_line_description: Decentralized weather-data oracles for Vietnamese crop insurance.
deals.editorial_note: SAMPLE. Parametric crop insurance needs oracles someone actually maintains. Agri-fintech angle makes this fundable.

deals.one_line_description: Onchain toll-road revenue securitization for Indonesian infrastructure.
deals.editorial_note: SAMPLE. Toll roads throw off exactly the cashflows tokenization was promised for. The week's headline round.

deals.one_line_description: Loyalty-points settlement network for SEA coffee chains.
deals.editorial_note: SAMPLE. Loyalty is where consumer crypto hides in plain sight. Ask how redemptions are funded before you cheer.

deals.one_line_description: Smart-contract audit shop trained on PH gaming exploits.
deals.editorial_note: SAMPLE. Regional audit capacity is thin; a specialist bench in Manila fills a real gap.

deals.one_line_description: Peer-to-peer rooftop-solar energy credits on a Malaysian appchain.
deals.editorial_note: SAMPLE. Energy tokenization pilots keep failing on the meter, not the chain. This team builds meters first.
